Government of India
Ministry of Labour and Employment
Shram Shakti Bhawan, New Delhi
Dated 29 January, 2026

To
The Addl. CS/SCS/Principal Secretary/Secretary,
Labour Department of all States/UTs

Subject: Key provisions under the Code on Social Security, 2020- reg.

Sir/Madam,

The Code on Social Security, 2020 has been enforced on 21.11.2025 with the objective to consolidate and simplify the existing social security laws into a single framework and to extend social security coverage to all workers, including organized, unorganized, gig, platform, and self-employed workers, by ensuring universal access to social security benefits, promoting portability of benefits across employments and States, enabling the Central and State Governments to frame appropriate schemes, leveraging technology for efficient delivery, and clearly defining the roles of governments, employers, and aggregators in order to provide comprehensive social protection to the workforce in line with evolving labour market conditions.

2. The Sections 154, 155 & 159 and 156 defines the power of Appropriate Government (Central/State), Central Government and State Government to make rules under the Code on Social Security, 2020. The details of sections on which rules are to be made by these Governments in their capacity as Appropriate Government, Central Government and State Government are given in Annexure A, B, C and D respectively, for reference. The details of sections on which Central Government will make schemes are also given in Annexure E.

3. The Code on Social Security, 2020 is available at https://labour.gov.in/sites/default/files/ss_code_gazette.pdf.

4. Annexure-C

Exclusive power of Central Government to make rules under Section 159 to give effect to arrangements with other countries for the transfer of money paid as compensation

Sl. No. 1 | Section 81
The Central Government may, by notification, make rules for the transfer to any foreign country of money deposited with a competent authority under Chapter VII which has been awarded to or may be due to, any person residing or about to reside in such foreign country and for the receipt, distribution and administration in any State of any money deposited under the law relating to employees' compensation in any foreign country, which has been awarded to, or may be due to any person residing or about to reside in any State:
Provided that no sum deposited under Chapter VII in respect of fatal accidents shall be so transferred without the consent of the employer concerned after the competent authority receiving the sum has passed orders determining its distribution and apportionment under section 81.

Sl. No. 2 | Section 81
Where money deposited with a competent authority has been so transferred in accordance with the rules made under this section, the provisions elsewhere contained in this Code regarding distribution by the competent authority of compensation deposited with him shall cease to apply in respect of any such money.
